rule: Per-source recorded disposition wins where reviewed (the ticket's 'evidenced licence basis'); the GL-GATE-07 LicenseRef rule fills the default (US -> LicenseRef-PublicRecord-FactualCompilation, non-US -> LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight). Federal-government works record their 17 U.S.C. §105 public-domain basis -> CC0-1.0. Decisions are source-scoped and append-only (rights_decision rows, ADR-095) — a claim's recorded rights_id is never rewritten. The hosted apply (sig-db rights-decisions --apply) is deferred with the live fetch under the OSM-land contention (D-R7.3-BREADTH); these sources hold no hosted claims yet.
